agyos_skill.intent: Market Sizer. Sizes your market the way investors check it: TAM top-down (population x share x spend a year), SAM bottom-up (customers you can reach x purchases a year x price) and SOM (the share of SAM you can win in N years, with a stated reason). Every input carries a source (a URL, a named publication, or an assumption said out loud), vague sources are refused, and it refuses any result that breaks SOM <= SAM <= TAM. Records sourced facts the deck quotes. Writes seed/market.json for the plan, the deck and the pitch coach. Use when the user says \
